author: Top Gear
description:
In this video, Top Gear reviews a potential new hot hatch king: the extreme Toyota GRMN Corolla. The bonnet, wings and rear spoiler are carbon, the tyres are sticky Michelin Cups 2s, the back seats have been ditched, and the chassis has been tuned pounding the ‘Ring (as GRMN stands for 'Gazoo Racing tuned by the Meister of Nürburgring’).
